Choose your Fusion models tuned

Pick the model each repository gets: by how often it changes, by how critical it is, or one by one in the table below, with a default for the rest. Every figure on this page follows as you change it.

Fusion cadence by change frequency

Every commit to the default branch runs a pipeline, so commit frequency sets the scan frequency. More than 5 commits a week means one Fusion scan a week, 1 to 5 means one every 2 weeks, and so on: the same rules as the Cx Credits Calculator. Credits = 10K units × Fusion scans × the model's credits per 10K LOC.
